_comment: Canonical RFC 9457 (application/problem+json) response bodies for common status codes. Copy the one you need and fill in `detail`/`instance`. See references/payloads-and-errors.md.

400.title: Malformed Request
400.detail: The request body could not be parsed as JSON.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.detail: The request is missing valid credentials.

403.title: Forbidden
403.detail: You do not have permission to access this resource.

404.title: Not Found
404.detail: No invoice exists with id inv_01H8X3Z9QK7N2M4P.

409.title: Conflict
409.detail: The invoice has already been sent and cannot be modified.

errors.message: must be a valid email address

429.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
429.detail: Too many requests. Retry after the window resets.
429._headers_reminder: Also set Retry-After, RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset — see references/auth-and-security.md.

500.title: Internal Server Error
500._reminder: Never include stack traces, SQL fragments, or file paths in `detail` — log them server-side instead.
